evidence_classes.google_event: empirical replay of one author-identified approximate event
evidence_classes.google_risk: retrospective frozen-ranking triage; not a decoder
evidence_classes.google_threshold_bootstrap: descriptive complete-shot threshold uncertainty; it neither replaces a frozen threshold nor enters a gate
evidence_classes.pnnl: constructed circuit-and-hardware snapshot-cohort boundary; not temporal drift
evidence_classes.pnnl_randomization: exact paired-swap implementation audit; not a natural-hardware null; it enters neither empirical gate nor the overall conjunction
evidence_classes.provenance: original pre-access detector freeze plus a separately ratified post-detector, pre-outcome consumer-validation repair and a separately ratified post-outcome publication-consumer repair

google_event.caption_contract: Left panel contains every frozen pre-event alert for every method. Right panel contains the first alert inside the primary window and all three predeclared window bands. The event location is approximate, not an exact onset.

google_randomization.caption_contract: Only proper-prior e-process crossings from 256 complete-shot randomization replicates are shown. No SR statistic exists in this result artifact and none may be reported.

google_risk.caption_contract: Both decoder-mismatch labels and budgets 2, 20, and 200 are shown with locked 95% complete-shot block-bootstrap intervals. Only correlated-matching capture at budget 20 enters the primary gate.

pnnl.caption_contract: Eleven path-level effects average logical states before macro aggregation. C01--C11 map through the cohort-control table. All 11 selected cohorts are circuit-and-hardware shifts; no equal-QASM controlled cohort is available.

repair_scope.claim: The execution repair and later publication-consumer amendment are disclosed; neither supports detector-blind, outcome-blind, or fully preregistered end-to-end language.

resource_scope: Google detector runtime is for the canonical joint pipeline; its randomization runtime is canonical-merge-only because external shard concurrency is not inferred. PNNL runtime is the whole auxiliary arm; peak RSS is process-wide. Per-method timing, memory, and relative-speed claims are unsupported.

result_narrative.abstract_finding: The composite missed the primary Google event window and captured 0 of 31 primary decoder mismatches at the top-20 budget, versus 9 for DFR and 0 for online logistic. Its PNNL macro restricted delay was 0.8046, versus 0.7899 for DFR and 0.8480 for online logistic; the required retention gate failed.
result_narrative.outcome_narrative: The Google gate failed: the composite had 0 pre-event alerts, missed the primary event window, and captured 0/31 primary mismatches at top 20, compared with 9/31 for DFR and 0/31 for online logistic. The PNNL gate failed: composite-minus-DFR macro delay was +0.0147, whereas composite-minus-logistic was -0.0434. Retention required strict improvement over both comparators.

google_threshold_bootstrap.caption_contract: All 2,000 complete-shot circular block-bootstrap rows use block length 128 and seeds 613000--614999. The table is descriptive only, does not replace frozen thresholds, and does not alter a locked Boolean.

pnnl_cohort_results.caption_contract: All 11 ordered state-averaged cohorts report pre-false-alarm mean, miss mean, and restricted delay for all five methods; the forest separately shows the two gate-relevant comparator differences.

pnnl_randomization.caption_contract: The exact 256-replicate paired-swap implementation audit reports all five methods over all 22 path-state episodes. It is not a natural-hardware null and enters neither empirical gate nor the overall conjunction.

pnnl_state_results.caption_contract: All 22 ordered path-state rows report pre-boundary false-alarm, miss, and restricted-delay values for all five methods; no path or state is selected.

unsupported_manuscript_fields.GOOGLE_CONTEXTUAL_BEST_METHOD: No endpoint or tie rule was frozen; post-hoc best-method selection is forbidden.
unsupported_manuscript_fields.GOOGLE_S_PACE_EVENT_SCORE_PERCENTILE: No event shot/role/denominator was frozen; omit this field.
unsupported_manuscript_fields.PNNL_PATHS_RETAINED: Retention is one Boolean aggregate rule, not a path count.
unsupported_manuscript_fields.POSITIVE_ALGORITHMIC_SUPERIORITY: A true conjunction records only satisfaction of both fixed empirical gates. It does not establish superiority over same-feature or same-parity logistic/threshold classes, a correct likelihood or oracle rule, or general algorithmic advantage.
unsupported_manuscript_fields.RANDOMIZATION_SR_SUMMARY: The Google randomization result has no SR field; remove it.
unsupported_manuscript_fields.S_PACE_PEAK_MEMORY_MIB: Peak RSS is process-wide; remove per-method memory.
unsupported_manuscript_fields.S_PACE_WALL_TIME_SECONDS: Only joint-pipeline timing is measured; remove per-method timing.

validated_descriptive_not_gate_fields.partial_trapezoidal_recall_area: Recomputed from the three locked risk-budget recall points with NumPy linear trapezoidal integration; descriptive only and absent from every locked Boolean.
